videos.title: Will the Midterm Elections Trigger a Q4 2018-style Market Regime?
videos.description:
Darius Dale joined Natalie Brunell to discuss why 42 he remains bullish over the medium term, even 42 Macro's quantitative systems signal a risk-off Market Regime in the near term.

Darius explained how a politically induced slowdown in data-center construction could trigger broader de-risking, while an eventual shift toward monetary debasement could support the longer-term outlook for gold and Bitcoin.
